title: Someone Who Stays For The Full Story
human_truth: The right love does not ask the expressive partner to compress themselves into the short version.
reader_identity_mirror: Send this to the partner who listens to your side plots, timeline jumps, and full dramatic version.
emotional_obstacle: Aachu’s full retelling could be dismissed as too long, too dramatic, or inconvenient.
aachu_proof: She performs the incident with gestures, side plots, and a timeline that loops back on itself.
zuv_role: He listens actively: phone down, body leaned in, amused and patient, making her full version feel safe.
emotional_arc: recognition -> comic escalation -> active attention -> tender thesis

slide_summaries.copy: With side plots nobody asked for.
And a timeline only they understand.
But he listens like it matters.
Maybe love is not asking for the short version.
Maybe it’s someone who stays for the full story.
